actionAdapters.entry: project-confirmed HostKey/NetCmd source and business request entry
actionAdapters.when: HTTP分支只修改已冻结的路由行/协议映射；复用或在任务授权内创建项目自有Service及调用入口。缺少现成Service不阻断，协议/认证/响应/幂等不明仍阻断

actionAdapters.entry: confirmed project-owned WebSocket business service, message dispatch and connection lifecycle entry
actionAdapters.when: WebSocket分支在精确地址、通道、协议、认证/心跳、ack、重放、连接拥有者和写集已确认时直接实现公开API调用；复用现有Service/Procedure/Event/UI，不套HTTP HostKey、主备或导出，不修改Framework或臆造初始化接口

actionAdapters.entry: current WebSocket NetworkComponent, IWebSocketManager, NetChannelBase and Tcp/TcpPb message public contracts
actionAdapters.when: 仅在WebSocket分支核对初始化、消息/回调所有权、默认与当前配置、账号/协议身份和平台条件；确认SpecialMessageCreator与认证状态真实路径，源码审查不算live验证
需要更新已确认的 NetworkComponent、NetworkSettings 或序列化引用

仅本轮修改已实际使用的HostKey/NetCmd/Proto源时定向导出；既有单URL取消维护或不使用这些表的普通HTTP跳过。Proto不支持data，Verify按版本2 Receipt完整输出/路径/类型/Hash核验，旧或缺项partial；HostKey Value列必需且有效行必填，FallbackValue可空或缺列，旧表仍校验主域名；官方模板XXXXX占位必须先替换，模板自身不视作项目正式导出

actionAdapters.entry: Nova.Network.LoadAsync / GetNetCmd / GetNetCmdUrl / ResolveNetCmdRow / ResolveHostKeyRow / SendProtoAsync / GetAsync / PostAsync / PostRawDataAsync / PostFileAsync
actionAdapters.when: HTTP业务源用正式Proto门面复用原AES/主备/取消/解析，不调用隐藏NetService；普通HTTP单URL无主备/retry，旧无ct入口保留，新ct-last重载全部原参数必填并要求ICancellableHttpManager；预取消不发送，在飞取消Update轮询Abort返回失败响应，所有最终HttpResponse必须继续await并finally唯一回池，退出主动Cancel且拒迟到，不以Dispose/Shutdown/AttachExternalCancellation替代；有限业务retry需明确幂等/状态/次数/退避；真实Play请求单独遵守精确授权，不套WebSocket；LoadAsync/路由只限实际用表分支；既有单URL生命周期维护保原协议/认证，仅核原端点/owner/manager/ct/响应与受控延迟probe，不强制新表导出或新账号

actionAdapters.entry: Nova.Network.ConnectServer / ReconnectServer / DisconnectServer / IsWebSocketConnected / IsWebSocketAuthenticatedSuccess / WebSocketNetChannels
actionAdapters.when: 仅在已确认WebSocket业务源中实现唯一连接拥有者与退出语义；void不是连接或认证成功，公开接口没有ct，重复ConnectServer不保证幂等

actionAdapters.entry: Nova.Network.CreateMessage / SendMessage / RecycleMessage / OnWebSocketReceiveMessage / OnWebSocketSendMessage + WebSocketScope.TcpMessage.Initialize / TcpPbMessage.Initialize
actionAdapters.when: 仅在已确认消息协议与真实通道的业务源中接收发送；true仅入队，成功交付后归通道持有，发送/接收回调返回后框架回收，业务只借用并拷贝，不双重回池或以SequenceID替代业务幂等身份

actionAdapters.entry: Unity compilation and existing WebSocket business entry Play state, message and lifecycle probe
actionAdapters.when: 编译后从实际入口验证唯一通道、连接/认证、消息/ack、断开与注销；重连仅精确授权测试环境，缺初始化/服务器/设备保留partial，不用Mock证明真服务

inputs.name: hostKeyAndNetCmdSource
inputs.description: 仅实际使用HostKey/NetCmd路由表的HTTP分支必需；既有单URL取消维护跳过表源/导出，WebSocket仅现项目确用这些表时需要

inputs.name: routeAndProtocolContract
inputs.description: 按分支核验：新协议接入必需正式协议/路由；既有单URL取消维护从现代码冻结原URL/方法/编码/响应且不改协议，不要求新增HostKey/NetCmd

inputs.name: authenticationContract
inputs.description: 新协议确认认证方式，可明确无认证；既有取消维护保留当前认证/请求体，不索取新账号或重新接协议

inputs.name: requestResponseAndReplaySemantics
inputs.description: 新协议或重放变更冻结正式请求/响应/重放语义；既有取消维护核原响应处理及最终失败/Unknown/唯一归池，不新增重试或服务端回滚承诺

inputs.name: testEndpointAccountAndSuccessProbe
inputs.description: 新协议接入需要精确测试端点与响应成功探针，账号仅认证要求时必需；既有单URL取消维护仅需要受控延迟取消探针，已存在请求/无认证GET不强制新账号

inputs.name: webSocketAddressChannelProtocolAuthenticationHeartbeatAndAck
inputs.description: WebSocket分支必需；冻结ws/wss地址、Tcp/TcpPb、帧/命令/响应、真实认证/心跳初始化与ack，不由HTTP协议或主备表推断

inputs.name: webSocketConnectionOwnerSubscriptionsMessageOwnershipReplayAndExit
inputs.description: WebSocket分支必需；明确Service/页面/Procedure拥有者、唯一通道、回调借用、迟到账号、退出及离线重放/业务幂等

inputs.name: confirmedProjectOwnedWebSocketWriteSetAndLocalProbe
inputs.description: WebSocket分支必需；精确source与必要序列化绑定由项目读取，probe验证真实入口而非调用存在；外部请求另行精确授权

inputs.name: networkExportSettingsSourcesTargetsAndScope
inputs.description: 仅 export-code-data 分支必需：冻结已保存活动场景、唯一 Nova/NetworkComponent、现有 NetworkSettings/ProtoSettings、scope=all/code、明确 targets 与对应权威源和正式输出；仅选中 hostkey 时核有效 ConfigRuntime.DevelopMode，proto 要求已确认 Schema/生成工具；不要求业务 Owner、HTTP/WebSocket 账号、端点或响应探针

inputs.name: httpCancellationOwnerManagerSupportAndResponseOwnership
inputs.description: 仅HTTP生命周期取消维护分支必需；核原URL/方法/协议与当前ICancellableHttpManager、全部原参数必填ct-last调用、退出主动Cancel/迟到拒绝、继续await/finally唯一归池及受控延迟探针；不要求新表导出/账号

inputs.name: activeConfigMasterAndGeneratedNamespace
inputs.description: 仅 export-code-data 按目标必需：Sound、Vibration 及 Network 含 hostkey/netcmd 的 all/code 导出，从 ProjectSettings/Nova/Globals.json 核 configMasterGuid、configMasterPathHint 与实际可加载 ConfigMasterSO 的一致身份，冻结其顶层 Namespace（RuntimeProvider.GetNamespace 的当前来源）及预期生成类型全名和既有消费者；未绑定、身份或值漂移时 blocked，不以 ConfigRuntime.Namespace、维度解析值或第一个 Master 代替。已绑定 Master 明确空 Namespace 时允许 global namespace 并按冻结预期验收。Network 仅 proto 时记录 Master 前置不适用，改核已确认 Schema/protoc 的命名空间与类型全名；不要求 ConfigRuntime、Collector、账号或端点，hostkey 原 DevelopMode 前置仍保留。

allow: confirmed HostKey and NetCmd source rows
confirmed NetworkComponent settings through Unity Editor or MCP
confirmed network generated output for the selected route
confirmed business request entry and its local verification probe
confirmed project-owned WebSocket service, message encoding/dispatch, connection owner, subscriptions, error/exit and idempotent ack consumer source
confirmed WebSocket component fields and necessary business binding only through selected nova-project-edit-settings or UI Operation and Unity Editor/MCP

confirmed project-owned HTTP Service creation/reuse, DTO/error mapping and finite idempotent business retry/signature renewal; standard Proto requestFactory only maps the supplied Header once, public facade does not manage identity

confirmed project-owned HTTP request lifecycle owner passing ct-last overloads, active Cancel, late-result guard and exactly-once HttpResponse finally return; optional ICancellableHttpManager support checked from the actual manager
deny: handwritten Prefab, Scene or Unity asset YAML
manual edits to generated network output
unconfirmed Proto schema, authentication, endpoint or server contract
internal NetService calls from business code
WebSocket Manager reinitialization, reflection or direct state writes to bypass missing authentication/heartbeat integration
business recycling or retaining pooled send/receive callback messages, arbitrary production socket or unconfirmed protocol/replay
unrelated HostKey, NetCmd, protocol source, service endpoint or production data

pretending old no-token ordinary HTTP or an implementation without ICancellableHttpManager has active physical cancellation, inventing single-URL framework failover, dropping pooled responses with AttachExternalCancellation, blindly replaying side-effect requests with Unknown delivery, or duplicating standard Proto/AES/primary-backup algorithms in project services

requiredFor: ambiguous current HTTP URL/method/protocol/request owner/cancellation/pooled-response behavior, or HostKey/NetCmd row/path only when the request actually uses these routes

unknown new-protocol authentication/response/replay/test endpoint/success probe, account only when authentication requires one, or unknown controlled delayed cancellation probe for existing single-URL lifecycle maintenance
ambiguous WebSocket address/channel, authentication/heartbeat contract, connection owner, pooled-message handling, ack, idempotency or exit behavior
create or replace a business request entry, WebSocket service/dispatch, Proto schema, generated type or NetworkComponent setting beyond existing authorized scope
credential use, production request, server-side write, delete, external write, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 先确认transport；HTTP冻结唯一路由，WebSocket冻结精确地址/通道、消息、认证/心跳与初始化、ack、连接拥有者/退出和消息池所有权。共用协议、重放、业务source与写集、测试端点、测试账号和成功探针，项目可读事实由Agent取得；现有精确授权持续有效，语义或目标变化后重新冻结。当前effects仅本地实现/配置/导出，真实服务请求及其自动副作用另行精确授权。 HTTP既有单URL生命周期维护复核现协议/认证与原URL、owner、真实取消能力和response所有权，跳过无关表导出/Network.LoadAsync/新账号；新协议及实际用表分支才要求对应全链输入。 完整业务接入的确认规则和全链输入适用于集成分支；export-code-data 只冻结 profile.requiredInputs、当前导出 Action 的 PlanId 与完整 writeSet。删除、外部写入、凭据、构建、替换非生成资产和 Git 等危险副作用的原确认门仍全部继承，不因 profile 覆盖或降低。
